name: qkd_rlyi_258

pin_regs.reason: KV-RTRUNK: a result-trunk station is ONE register stage pin to pin (inject: a / y -> 2:1 -> flop -> b; header: trunk words -> AND / 2:1 -> flop -> beat word); its flop is the pin register of every pin; pv_trunk_gen counts exactly 1 core cycle per station (RS_D), so a flow-inserted pin register would change the static beat schedule

job.purpose: KV-RTRUNK 10-17: PV pair result-trunk INJECT station qkd_rlyi_258 (b <= s ? y : a, 258 b = 256 data + V + T, one register per bit, no reset: flush rule), 21.6 x 95.04 um (the 21.6-um lane of the relay standards; W face a + y 516 pins = 5.4 /um, E face b 258), 64 per pair (tools/qwen_kv_die/pv_trunk_gen.py)

structural_change: KV-RTRUNK 10-17: new element (no closed predecessor): the PV pair successor qkd_pvw_die_t gains two 512-b result trunks (tools/qwen_kv_die/pv_trunk_gen.py) feeding pvfin.p0 / p1
